LOW.text: Your time management is good! Here's how to maintain it:
tips: Use a planner or digital calendar
Block out study time for each subject
resources: Planner templates available at Student Success

MEDIUM.text: Time management could be improved. Try these strategies:
tips: Create a fixed daily study schedule
Use the 2:1 ratio (2 hours study : 1 hour work)
Set specific goals for each study session

HIGH.text: Your time management is critically impacting your studies.
tips: Consider reducing work hours or course load
Create emergency study plan for this week
resources: Student Success Coordinator - assigned to you
